第49章 23次吻戏-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

下一章

“过来？我去你的经纪公司？”

好姐姐惊讶地看着他。

两个月前，对方还在她的庇护下成长。

现在一转眼，居然要自己成立经纪公司！！

倒反天罡了属于是。

这发展太快，让人反应不过来。

不过，作为在娱乐圈混了7年的老人，秦兰温声劝道：“不是姐不相信你的能力，咱们这一行没这么好做的。”

“你想要开经纪公司，需要资源，需要人脉！！”

“还有，你不是签约太合麦田吗？”

“我只是签了唱片合约，经纪约在我手上。”

魏沐解释一下。

他不打算签约任何经纪公司。

等7月份首张专辑问世，人气火爆，正好借助这波人气招兵买马，成立公司为自己服务。

“到时候你过来就是公司一姐！！”

秦兰甩了个白眼，你当我三岁小孩呢？

还一姐，你那公司就你一个，我过去当然是一姐....

难不成还是二姐？

见对方不为所动，魏老板开始打感情牌，上前握住秦兰的手，眼神真挚的看着她：“姐。你是我唯一的姐。”

“在这个圈子，我们才是相依为命的一家人。别人不可能有我对你好！！”

说就说，你拉我手干嘛？

不动声色的抽回手，秦兰嘴角上扬，带着一丝调笑。

“少跟我来这一套，你以为我是小姑娘，随便几句话就被你骗？”

“这怎么能叫骗，我的实力摆在这。等7月份专辑发售，我就是最火的歌手。”

秦兰轻哼一句，伸手轻轻捏着小坏蛋的鼻子：“到时候再说，我的合约还有一年，急不得。”

没给她反应时间，魏沐再次握住她的手，眼神充满了自信和火热。

“好啊，到时候你可别反悔。”

秦兰耳根子一红，眼神闪躲一下，再次把手抽回来。

“先吃饭，吃完饭我送你回去！！”

在横店待了三天，魏沐没闲着。

一边陪着秦兰，一边和京城那边沟通MV的拍摄计划。

《体面》的MV还是照着原版电影来。

有满分作业抄，没必要自己琢磨。

反复琢磨，还不如人家原版好。

《前任3》的故事很简单，就是一对相识于微末的情侣，最后分手的故事。

整个MV的主要角色有四个，除了魏沐和糖嫣，还要再找一对情侣。

其中一个是余飞，郑凯本色出演。

还有一个是丁点，这个角色性格活泼，他联系了李金明。

........

三天后，太合麦田总部。

为了准备此次MV，老板宋柯特地批准了一个办公室，专门用来给拍摄团队办公。

“哎，你是第一次来这地方？”

"Come here? Shall I go to your agency?"

The good sister looked at him in surprise.

Two months ago, the other party was growing up under her protection.

Now in the blink of an eye, I actually want to set up my own brokerage company!!

On the contrary, it belongs to Tiangang.

This is developing too fast for people to react.

However, as an old man who has been in the entertainment industry for 7 years, Qin Lan gently advised: "It's not that I don't believe in your ability, our industry is not so easy to do."

"If you want to open a brokerage company, you need resources and connections!!"

"Also, didn't you sign a contract with Taihe Maitian?"

“I just signed a record deal and my manager made the appointment with me.”

Wei Mu explains.

He has no plans to sign with any agency.

When the first album came out in July, it became very popular, so he took advantage of this wave of popularity to recruit people and set up a company to serve himself.

"When the time comes, you will be the first sister of the company!!"

Qin Lan rolled his eyes, do you think I am a three-year-old?

You are also the first sister. You are the only one in your company. Of course I used to be the first sister...

Could it be that she is still the second sister?

Seeing that the other party was unmoved, Boss Wei started to play the emotional card. He stepped forward to hold Qin Lan's hand and looked at her sincerely: "Sister. You are my only sister."

"In this circle, we are a family that depends on each other. No one else can be as good to you as I am!!"

Just say it, why are you holding my hand?

Quietly withdrawing his hand, Qin Lan raised the corners of his mouth with a hint of teasing.

"Don't do this with me. Do you think I'm a little girl who can be deceived by you just by saying a few words?"

"How can this be called cheating? My strength lies here. When the album is released in July, I will be the most popular singer."

Qin Lan hummed softly, stretched out his hand and gently pinched the little villain's nose: "We will wait until then. My contract still has one year left, so there is no rush."

Without giving her time to react, Wei Mu held her hand again, his eyes full of confidence and passion.

"Okay, don't regret it then."

Qin Lan's ears turned red, his eyes averted, and he pulled his hand back again.

"Eat first, I'll take you back after dinner!!"

After staying in Hengdian for three days, Wei Mu was not idle.

While accompanying Qin Lan, he communicated with Beijing about the MV shooting plan.

The MV for "Decent" is still based on the original movie.

There is no need to think about it on your own when there are homework copies for full marks.

After thinking about it again and again, it's not as good as the original version.

The story of "Exes 3" is very simple. It's the story of a couple who met at a young age and finally broke up.

There are four main characters in the entire MV. In addition to Wei Mu and Tang Yan, we also need to find another couple.

One of them is Yu Fei, played by Zheng Kai in his true self.

There is also Ding Dian, a character with a lively personality. He contacted Li Jinming.

........

Three days later, Taihe Wheatfield Headquarters.

In order to prepare for this MV, boss Song Ke specially approved an office specifically for the filming team.

"Hey, is this your first time coming to this place?"
